scope: Measured compute-cost and claim-boundary audit for the P2 source used by Phase-1 I8/I16/I32. This artifact does not change or authorize any active run, gate, baseline, or controller action.

source_probe.hardware: 4 GPUs on the same server class used for Phase-1 training

measured_probe_timing.interpretation: The wall interval is corroborated by the 13 logged step timings. Full-gradient probe backward dominates the measured cost; this is not primarily an idle-file or postprocessing interval.

cost_comparison.reuse_policy: The fixed P2 is reused across I8/I16/I32 and all training seeds in this model/task setting. The measured cost is paid once for this setting, not once per Phase-1 run.
cost_comparison.portability_policy: A new model or task requires a new probe unless an independently validated transfer protocol is specified; the current fixed P2 cannot be treated as zero-cost universal metadata.

measurement_limits: This is the measured cost of the current shared Phase-0.5 pipeline, not a proof that an optimized P2-only implementation cannot be faster.
The pipeline jointly produced multiple diagnostics/candidates, although generation and full-gradient backward dominate the measured time and are shared by P2.
Evaluation wall time is excluded from both sides of the training-side percentages; identical fixed evaluation should be reported separately for every method.
Wall-time-equivalent steps are descriptive and do not imply that 34 additional standard-LoRA steps are statistically or optimization-wise equivalent to the probe.

required: Report the 4.911-hour probe wall time and approximately 19.65 four-GPU-hours separately from I8 training.
Report method training wall/GPU-hours and complete pipeline wall/GPU-hours, with the one-time probe amortization rule stated explicitly.
Label the planned 50-step I8-versus-standard-LoRA comparison as equal training steps and matched training protocol, not equal total compute.
For cross-model or cross-task results, charge a newly measured probe cost to each new setting unless the same probe is legitimately shared.
forbidden_without_a_separate_compute_mat: I8 is more compute efficient than standard LoRA.
I8 reaches the result with equal total compute.
The P2 initialization is free or negligible.
The measured probe cost can be omitted because it is amortized across two seeds.

execution_policy.compute_matched_extension: Not authorized by this audit. The current paper plan may report equal-step accuracy and full measured cost while making no compute-efficiency claim.
